dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Steady symmetrical narrowing from the widest mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Symmetrical outward bulges at the pectoral flipper locations with smooth tapering posteriorly.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white across the visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single dark high-contrast point (blowhole) on the anterior dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible longitudinal dorsal ridge casting a sharp shadow along the central posterior axis.
